v0_13_0.title: Public Prompt Library, Legal Agreements & Policy Admin
v0_13_0.body: Public prompt library launched with license badges and source attribution; legal agreement system and policy management dashboard built; interaction optimization and navigation redesign.
items: Public prompt library launched: 533 curated prompts with multilingual browsing and save to private library
Public prompt license badges: transparent capsule tags (CC BY 4.0 / MIT) with source links on cards
Dynamic legal pages: Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Legal Disclaimer fetch from backend API, admin-editable
Policy management dashboard (zeroexo_admin): admins can create/edit/delete/toggle visibility online
Unified policy page: redesigned with left LOGO menu + right Markdown content area
Login page footer and help menu consolidated into single policy announcement entry
Cleaned up redundant routes: privacy/terms/disclaimer/about/follow pages merged into unified policy page
Favorite prompt optimization: duplicate prevention, post-favorite dialog with 'Continue browsing' or 'Go view'
Enhanced card interactions: hover zoom effects, custom skeleton loading, transparent capsule license badges
Changelog improvements: red strikethrough for deprecated items, policy announcement sidebar navigation
Navigation optimization: GitHub tooltip changed to 'Help & Feedback', user menu renamed to 'Account'

v0_12_0.title: Asset Library Renamed and Module Cleanup
v0_12_0.body: Unified asset library management, cleaned up legacy modules, replaced context menu and user menu components.
items: test-library officially renamed to asset-library, copy unified to "Assets"
Cleaned up legacy asset-library / prompt-library modules
Replaced legacy ContextMenu plugin with custom component, supports theme adaptation
Replaced legacy ProfileDropdown with custom component, removed Antd Dropdown dependency
Removed legacy @zeroexo/plugin-context-menu plugin and all dependencies

v0_11_0.title: Project Cards: 3D Flip and Select Mode
v0_11_0.body: Enhanced project card interaction with 3D flip and batch selection support.
items: Project cards now support 3D flip with rename/delete on the back
Fixed select mode, added checkboxes in top-left for select-all and batch delete
Added new project placeholder cards on Creation and Canvas pages
New projects use auto-incrementing names (Untitled, Untitled 2...)
Fixed nested input box issue on home page

v0_10_0.title: Asset Library Architecture Upgrade
v0_10_0.body: Refactored asset library to folder architecture with drag-and-drop management and directory browsing.
items: Asset library switched to folder architecture with multi-level directories
Drag assets to other folders, including parent directory
Added directory browser button for quick folder navigation
Cards now have action buttons (rename, move, delete)
Delete uses Antd Modal confirmation, screen-centered
Filter buttons use small radius style, distinguished from category tags

v0_9_0.title: Sync Mechanism and Tactile Buttons
v0_9_0.body: Introduced cloud sync diff analysis and Magnetic effect button.
items: Implemented front-end and back-end sync diff detection, supports local/cloud/skip
Added MagneticButton follow effect for enhanced interaction
Fixed HMR-causing subjects.filter not a function error
Fixed antd Modal deprecated property compatibility (maskClosable → mask)

v0_8_0.title: Backend API Refactor and Route Fix
v0_8_0.body: Unified backend route prefixes, fixed multi-module route conflicts.
items: Fixed backend route prefix, removed duplicate api/ prefix
Registered FoldersModule and SubjectsModule to app.module
Added Subject model fields (version, lastSyncedAt)
Cleaned up unused imports, regenerated Prisma Client
All API endpoints protected by JWT guard

v0_7_0.title: Canvas Editor and Plugin System
v0_7_0.body: Integrated Canvas editor and established plugin architecture.
items: Integrated @zeroexo plugin system (render-react/interaction/selection)
Implemented canvas node drag, resize, and marquee selection
Registered node types (image/video/audio/text)
Implemented Minimap thumbnail and History undo/redo
Integrated AI Provider plugin architecture

v0_6_0.title: Mobile Adaptation and Theme System
v0_6_0.body: Improved mobile responsive layout and established global theme system.
items: Unified mobile navigation drawer (MobileNavDrawer)
All pages adapted to light/dark theme switching
Global icons use Lucide library with hover scale animation
Fixed body overflow scrolling issue

v0_5_0.title: Project Setup Workbench
v0_5_0.body: Implemented multi-step project setup flow with AI scheme generation support.
items: Simplified project creation with just name input
AI report and scheme generation integrated in setup workbench
Project data managed through single project.config source
Stage navigation uses left sidebar (Done/Current/Locked)

v0_4_0.title: Foundation Architecture
v0_4_0.body: Established project base framework, configured development environment and core dependencies.
items: Set up React 19 + TypeScript frontend project framework
Configured NestJS backend service with PostgreSQL database
Integrated Antd UI component library and i18n internationalization
Established base routing system and user authentication module
